verdict.rationale: Rev AI's own API documents retrieving transcripts as JSON, with word-level timestamps, or as plaintext, so job outputs can leave in open formats. Nothing shows an account-wide export or a documented path for leaving. Missing for 10: bulk export of all account data (jobs, media, custom vocabularies, settings), account or data deletion and offboarding docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
